about: Which team each session belongs to, for machines. teams/README.md is the text people read, and the two are kept in step. The session-observability plugin puts the team in every binding line (jgwill/miadi-orchestration-kit#56). Rules, in order: a declared team (MIADI_TEAM in the agent's environment, or the tmux session option @miadi-team), then sessions (the tmux session name or the agent session's name), then folders (the agent's folder or one below it, longest prefix wins), then name_patterns (regular expressions on the same two names). Otherwise the team is unassigned.
criteria_about: criteria: each team's responsibility as a program reads it, so that a piece of work can be matched to the team that carries it (the routing step proposed in Episode 575's staging folder routing-a-decomposition-to-teams-261113, tried as an alpha in jgwill/mia-code `miaco route`, which reads desired_outcome, makes and boundary). purpose says in one sentence what the team is for. desired_outcome quotes William where the README does. relations names, for each other team (or the production team, the people who decide), what passes between them. Boundaries other than T8's were read from their sections on 2026-11-13 by the seat t8-miaco-route-alpha-2611132120; purpose and relations were written on 2026-11-20 by the seat t8-team-definitions-2611201455 from the sources its README section names. Each lead corrects them. Change the README and these fields together.
